name: tide
description: A tiling desktop environment for chromeOS: a window manager that places your windows, and a dashboard.

focus-next.description: Focus the next window in the stack (Search+J)

focus-prev.description: Focus the previous window in the stack (Search+K)

popup.description: Open the dashboard: workspaces, clocks and the launcher (Search+Space)

swap-master.description: Swap the window with the master (Search+Shift+M)

attention.description: Go to the window wanting attention, else the last window (Search+Tab)

move-next.description: Move the window down the stack (Search+Shift+J)

move-prev.description: Move the window up the stack (Search+Shift+K)

send-next.description: Send the window to the next workspace (Search+Shift+PageDown)

send-prev.description: Send the window to the previous workspace (Search+Shift+PageUp)

workspace-last.description: Go to the last workspace other than home (Search+End)

workspace-go.description: Go to a workspace by name (Search+W)

workspace-move.description: Move the window to a workspace by name (Search+Shift+W)

workspace-1.description: Go to the 1st workspace in the bar (Search+1)

workspace-2.description: Go to the 2nd workspace in the bar (Search+2)

workspace-3.description: Go to the 3rd workspace in the bar (Search+3)

workspace-4.description: Go to the 4th workspace in the bar (Search+4)

workspace-5.description: Go to the 5th workspace in the bar (Search+5)

workspace-6.description: Go to the 6th workspace in the bar (Search+6)

workspace-7.description: Go to the 7th workspace in the bar (Search+7)

workspace-8.description: Go to the 8th workspace in the bar (Search+8)

workspace-9.description: Go to the 9th workspace in the bar (Search+9)

send-1.description: Send the window to the 1st workspace in the bar (Search+Shift+1)

send-2.description: Send the window to the 2nd workspace in the bar (Search+Shift+2)

send-3.description: Send the window to the 3rd workspace in the bar (Search+Shift+3)

send-4.description: Send the window to the 4th workspace in the bar (Search+Shift+4)

send-5.description: Send the window to the 5th workspace in the bar (Search+Shift+5)

send-6.description: Send the window to the 6th workspace in the bar (Search+Shift+6)

send-7.description: Send the window to the 7th workspace in the bar (Search+Shift+7)

send-8.description: Send the window to the 8th workspace in the bar (Search+Shift+8)

send-9.description: Send the window to the 9th workspace in the bar (Search+Shift+9)

app-calendar.description: Open app 1, Google Calendar unless changed in tide's options (Search+C)

app-chat.description: Open app 2, Google Chat unless changed in tide's options (Search+Shift+C)

app-meet.description: Open app 3, Google Meet unless changed in tide's options (Search+M)

app-music.description: Open app 4, YouTube Music unless changed in tide's options (Search+Y)
